digest.component_or_area: rebar-implement skill and shared test-design documentation
propositions: Surface-parity census must enumerate five parallel slots (CLI, MCP-API, library-facade, automated-callers, dual-direction) with in-scope-and-proven or out-of-scope-with-reason disposition for each.
Config-effect contrast tests must prove each config key changes behavior through the real read path using default vs non-default comparison, not merely verify parsing.
Changes composing locked operations, check-then-act patterns, or cache/snapshot logic must route contention cases to existing shared suites by shape rather than introduce bespoke harnesses.
Behavioral gate findings require RED test FIRST in the same amended change before the fix is applied; non-behavioral findings are exempt.
Residual-gap disposition sweep must enumerate all out-of-scope census slots and known gaps with forced-artifact wording (filed, accepted, fixed, or none).
